verdict.rationale: The evidence pack only covers backing up/restoring Authenticator's own accounts via cloud backup, exporting passwords, and standard account setup via QR/manual entry — there is no mention of any bulk-import feature for pulling tokens from other authenticator apps (e.g., Google Authenticator, Aegis) into Microsoft Authenticator. Community evidence even suggests the opposite direction problem (comm-6: MS's QR codes are non-standard so other apps reject them), reinforcing that cross-app portability isn't supported.
